birth.date_confidence: Birth year unknown. Wikipedia's infobox gives c. 1471 and its own body text c. 1466, an internal discrepancy in the source itself; the age of 48 or 49 it states at death on 29 June 1520 is consistent only with c. 1471, while indigenous chronicles give 52 years. The date field defaults to 1466-01-01 to order the segment and asserts nothing.

stops.stop: Tenochtitlan, the death
stops.date_confidence: The 29 June date is conventional rather than proven; the death falls in the last days of June 1520. Cause and perpetrator are unresolved. Spanish accounts have him die of the stoning and of tearing off his bandages and refusing food; nearly all surviving indigenous-derived sources say the Spaniards stabbed or strangled him. Wikipedia gives his age as 48 or 49, indigenous chronicles as 52, a figure some scholars read as the length of the calendar cycle rather than a life. Coordinates are inherited byte-identical from the same event in cortes.journey.json, though the death occurred inside the palace pinned at 19.434, -99.1335 elsewhere in this file.

stops.stop: Copolco, the burning
stops.date_confidence: The cremation at Copolco is recorded in Book XII of the Florentine Codex, a Nahua account compiled decades after the event. Copolco's archaeological footprint is not fixed; the coordinate approximates the northern lake-edge district generally assigned to it, and a second value, 19.4361, -99.14, circulates for the same event in the research material. The day is an ordering device.
